verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own site states that Sprite disks grow as you write to them, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and that you are billed only for the bytes actually stored. Both parts of the story (auto-growth and billing for bytes written) are explicitly claimed, though only for Sprites and only in one marketing line. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the storage growth and billing mechanics, confirmation that the same model applies to Fly Machines volumes, guidance on behaviour beyond the 100 GB cap, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know attached disk/storage auto-grows with usage and I'm billed only for bytes actually written rather than pre-provisioned capacity

citations.quote: Your disk grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there.
you only pay for the compute, storage, and bandwidth you actually use
